name_reason: Compliant with the global naming rule data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> for a battle core table (data_fd2_battle_*). The descriptor reflects both the role (spell-cast cinematic handler dispatch) and the data type (_table = function-pointer table). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to 0x523B9 or to any entry address). The '10' dimension is implicit in the C array type. Verified by xrefs-from (all 10 slots point to fd2_tick_summon_* / render functions, contiguous block 0x26152..0x276EB) and by the dispatch-site disassembly (FF /4 indirect call indexed by spell_id).
purpose: Summon/spell-cast cinematic tick dispatch table: 10 function pointers indexed by spell_id, each driving one spell's cinematic animation phases.
logic_summary: 10 x 32-bit function pointers (40 bytes) at 0x523B9, indexed by spell_id and invoked through the pointer as a 5-arg cdecl: int (*)(caster_unit_id, caster_sprite_handle, dst_workbuf, row_stride, phase_code). The dispatch site (fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence) loads spell_id into EAX and does CALL dword ptr [EAX*4 + 0x523B9] then ADD ESP,0x14; the returned int is the per-phase frame count driving the surrounding blit loop. Each handler branches internally on the phase_code arg (e.g. slot 0 fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot CMPs the phase code against 3/4/5 and returns the frame count in EAX). Slots: 0 fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot, 1 fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring, 2 fd2_tick_summon_spell_animation_state, 3 fd2_tick_summon_spell_main_animation_state, 4 fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_a_6slot, 5 fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot, 6 fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial, 7 fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot, 8 fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_e_16slot, 9 fd2_tick_summon_spell_minor_animation_state.
datatype: int (*[10])(uint32, uint32, uint32, uint32, uint32) -- 10-entry array of cdecl function pointers, stride 4, 40 bytes total
element_semantics: Each element is the entry address of a per-spell summon/cinematic tick handler (fd2_tick_summon_* / fd2_render_*). Indexed by spell_id (0..9 used). Called with (caster_unit_id, caster_sprite_handle, dst_workbuf, row_stride, phase_code); returns the per-phase frame count (int) used by the caller's blit loop.
notes: src comment block (btltab.c lines 474-527) already complete and accurate: matches the memory image byte-for-byte (00026152 000262EF 00026528 00026795 000269D3 00026BFD 00026E39 000272B8 000274B0 000275D6), the 14 read/call xrefs (10 in fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence + 4 in fd2_animate_spell_hit_cinematic), the FF /4 dispatch disassembly, the element type, and read-only status. The C declaration is intentionally NON-const (int (*[10])(...)) to match the void/int (*[N])(...) extern in globals.h, identical to sibling dispatch tables data_fd2_battle_spell_handler_table @ 0x51D01 and data_fd2_battle_ai_post_action_consequence_table @ 0x51B91; this is the standard fn-ptr-table contract, not a const demote-for-tests. Ghidra data plate at 0x523B9 was previously empty (NULL); created a concise plate (PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline) reflecting the src conclusion.
